Facts used:
- Ossbridge’s 2025 budget was 9,284.5 million tenge, and its 2025 population was 52,904 residents. [NR-01]
- Ashgrove’s 2025 budget was 10,488.1 million tenge, and its 2025 population was 58,760 residents. [NR-10]
- Harrowfield’s 2025 budget was 16,021.7 million tenge, and its 2025 population was 90,212 residents. [NR-07]
- One million tenge equals 1,000,000 tenge. [NR-01, NR-07, NR-10]

Calculations:
- Ossbridge: 9,284.5 × 1,000,000 ÷ 52,904 = 175,471.135 tenge per resident.
- Ashgrove: 10,488.1 × 1,000,000 ÷ 58,760 = 178,489.789 tenge per resident.
- Harrowfield: 16,021.7 × 1,000,000 ÷ 90,212 = 177,592.761 tenge per resident.
- Largest: Ashgrove at 178,489.789 tenge per resident.
- Lowest: Ossbridge at 175,471.135 tenge per resident.
- Difference: 178,489.789473... − 175,471.135... = 3,018.654 tenge per resident.

ANSWER: Ashgrove | 3018.654
